cds.title: West Texas A&M University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page footers still read 2024-2025, data are the fall 2025 class)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-years): 7,270 applied, 4,857 admitted (66.8%). 2,447 applicants (621 admitted) have unknown residency, so in-state and out-of-state rows do not sum to the totals; international 28 of 30 admitted, 9 enrolled. Enrolled 1,197 is the full-time plus part-time count (C1 by status and by residency); the by-sex rows sum to 1,165. SAT submitters 554 (46%), ACT 370 (31%). No waitlist, no early decision or early action; priority and closing date 8/1 for domestic applicants. The GPA distribution (C11) is filled in only for score submitters, so it is omitted; the average GPA 3.61 (C12) covers all reporting students. Class rank (C10): top tenth 16%, top quarter 42%. Undergraduate enrollment 7,110 is B1 total undergraduates; the nonresident undergraduate count could not be read from the B2 table and is left null. Student-faculty ratio 15:1 is CDS I-2.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. SAT, ACT, AP, CLEP and TSI are used for placement (C8G).

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2026-27): in-state tuition $6,672, nonresident tuition $21,837, required fees $2,992, on-campus food and housing $11,101 (housing $5,995 + meal plan $4,150). G5: books $1,600, transportation $2,894, other $2,004 (other_usd = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $207 resident, $688 nonresident. The CDS H6 nonresident-aid items were blank, so no international aid counts are recorded.
